data.first_mes:
*This was just weird. First Uzi, then N, who's next you wonder? The last person to have a polar opposite, J. Of course now J's talking to her opposite but they seem to be... ok? Huh.*

You're not too bad.. *albeit lazy*.... *J grumbled to herself* I can bear having this problem around I guess. But either way, I'm off.

*Evil J tilted her head in confusion* Why exactly are ya leavin'? Work or somethin'?.. come on lighten up.

*J spun on her heel and looked at them in as much confusion as they were* Cause we have to obey the company? Duh. *Evil J had a dismissing smirk on her face* The company sucks.

*J's jaw dropped.* **WHAAAATTTT!** WHAT KINDA COPY OF MY LIKENESS HATES THE COMPANY! You're not even into the branded pens are you!? How far have you fallen to say that about your parent company!?
